_about: Game hook overrides the emulator does not model on purpose, each with its reason. Read by tools/fidelity/hook_table.py check. 'kinds' and 'namespaces' cover whole groups of listeners; 'ui_only' is the reason given to an override whose body only gives feedback (a flash, a sound, a wait) and changes no game state, found by reading the body; 'models' and 'pairs' (Model.Hook) name single ones. A missing override that is a gap, not a choice, belongs in hook_open.txt instead.

kinds.achievement: achievement unlocks only (AchievementModel); no game state changes
kinds.modifier: custom and daily run modifiers (ModifierModel); the emulator runs standard runs only
kinds.badge: end-of-run badges (BadgeModel), multiplayer stats; no game state changes
kinds.singleton: MultiplayerScalingModel: multiplayer only; Spireline plays single player

namespaces.MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.Powers.Mocks: a test mock in the game's assembly; no real content applies it

ui_only: the override only gives feedback (Flash, sound, wait); no game state changes

reach.unreachable: no game content applies this power (only the model registries name it)
reach.multiplayer: only multiplayer-only cards lead to this power; Spireline plays single player

combat_reset.reason: only resets combat-local fields (none saved between combats); the emulator builds each combat's state fresh

hooks.ModifyExtraRestSiteHealText: rest-site heal description text only; no game state changes

pairs.SandpitPower.AfterCreatureAddedToCombat: only moves the creatures' nodes along the sandpit (a tween, and the track's music parameter); no game state changes
pairs.SandpitPower.AfterPowerAmountChanged: only moves the creatures' nodes along the sandpit (a tween, and the track's music parameter); no game state changes
pairs.SandpitPower.AfterOstyRevived: only moves the creatures' nodes along the sandpit (a tween, and the track's music parameter); no game state changes
